class.name: Transform2DSpreener
class.brief_description: Interpolates an [Object]'s [Transform2D] property based on the damping ratio and halflife of a spring.
class.description: [Transform2DSpreener] is used to interpolate a [Transform2D] property of an object. See [method Spreen.spreen_transform_2d]. [b]Note:[/b] [method Spreen.spreen_transform_2d] is the only correct way to create [Transform2DSpreener]. Any [Transform2DSpreener] created manually will not function correctly.

method.name: update_goal
method.description: Updates the goal of the [Transform2DSpreener] in real time. When used in tandem with [method Spreen.set_finishable] can be used to dampen noisy inputs.
